speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody had a new agentic tool, Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS.

speaker: Unknown
en: Claude Code basically changed the game when it came out last March.

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody was using this stuff.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 然后我想不到 24 小时后,或者说两天后,他再次发推说,智能体 AI 刚刚毁掉了我的产品,删除了我的生产数据库,还有谁敢用智能体 AI?

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing is, AI agents are very powerful, but they create problems.
zh: 问题是,AI 智能体非常强大,但它们也会制造问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone here familiar with OpenClaw?
zh: 在座的各位熟悉 OpenClaw 吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: So what's the deal with OpenClaw?
zh: 那 OpenClaw 是怎么回事?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a really, really cool tool.
zh: 它是一个非常、非常酷的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can put your own AI on a computer, and it can essentially be your personal assistant, do all of this really, really awesome stuff for you.
zh: 你可以把自己的 AI 装到一台电脑上,它基本上可以成为你的私人助理,为你做所有这些非常、非常棒的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've probably seen everyone is saying, if you're going to use OpenClaw, you need to buy Mac Mini and put it on a different computer than your personal computer, right?
zh: 你们大概见过,大家都在说,如果你要用 OpenClaw,你需要买一台 Mac Mini,把它放在和你的个人电脑不同的另一台电脑上,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it's got all these security vulnerabilities.
zh: 因为它有所有这些安全漏洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: The last thing you want is OpenClaw to go download all of your sensitive files, put it up on the internet, download viruses on the internet, put that on your laptop, and then delete all your personal files so that you don't have them, but the rest of the world does.
zh: 你最不想要的就是 OpenClaw 去下载你所有的敏感文件,把它们传到互联网上,再从互联网上下载病毒,装到你的笔记本上,然后删除你所有的个人文件,让你自己没有这些文件,而世界上的其他人却有。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are quite a few issues with agents that we are still wrapping our heads around and how to securely develop with AI agents.
zh: 智能体有相当多的问题,我们仍在努力理解,以及如何安全地用 AI 智能体进行开发。

speaker: Unknown
en: So today I'm going to spend a little bit of time talking about the lethal trifecta if you haven't heard of it and how Coder is addressing the principles of agentic security and how folks are coming to us so that they can address these problems and scale out AI at their company.
zh: 所以今天我会花一点时间讲讲致命三要素,如果你没听说过的话,以及 Coder 如何落实智能体安全的原则,以及大家如何找上我们,以便他们能解决这些问题,并在他们的公司规模化部署 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a little bit about Coder.
zh: 简单介绍一下 Coder。

speaker: Unknown
en: Coder was founded in 2017.
zh: Coder 创立于 2017 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was founded by three teenagers who were making Minecraft mods, and they got tired of having to configure VMs constantly to run Minecraft so that they could develop mods on it.
zh: 它由三个制作 Minecraft 模组的青少年创立,他们厌倦了为了运行 Minecraft 而不断配置虚拟机以便在其中开发模组。

speaker: Unknown
en: Somehow they stumbled on an $80 million company.
zh: 不知怎的,他们摸索成了一家 8000 万美元的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're very proud of them.
zh: 我们为他们感到非常骄傲。

speaker: Unknown
en: What Coder does is it delivers consistent, reliable, and secure remote development environments.
zh: Coder 所做的,是提供一致、可靠且安全的远程开发环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those environments can be stood up pretty much anywhere you want.
zh: 这些环境几乎可以在你想要的任何地方搭建起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're configured with Terraform.
zh: 它们用 Terraform 配置。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're open source.
zh: 我们是开源的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're model agnostic.
zh: 我们对模型不可知(不绑定特定模型)。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're cloud agnostic.
zh: 我们对云不可知(不绑定特定云)。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can host this on-premise.
zh: 你可以在本地部署(on-premise)托管它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we find that
zh: 而且我们发现,

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a really, really good solution if you need a self-hosted model for developer environments or agentic environments.
zh: 如果你需要一个自托管的模型用于开发者环境或智能体环境,这是一个非常、非常好的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're trusted by some of the biggest companies here in the United States and across Europe.
zh: 我们被美国和欧洲各地一些最大的公司所信赖。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here are some of the names on our board.
zh: 这里是一些我们董事会上的名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're in, I believe, six of the top ten big banks, lots of hedge funds, lots of three-letter government agencies.
zh: 我们进入了我相信是前十的大银行中的六家,还有很多对冲基金,很多三字母缩写的政府机构。

speaker: Unknown
en: Essentially,
zh: 本质上,

speaker: Unknown
en: If a SaaS model doesn't work for you, if you've got on-prem infrastructure, if you cannot have code sitting on a developer's laptop or in some kind of perimeter that you cannot control, code is usually a good solution, just like these companies need it.
zh: 如果 SaaS 模式不适合你,如果你有本地部署的基础设施,如果你不能让代码放在开发者的笔记本电脑上或放在某种你无法控制的边界内,那么代码通常是一个好的解决方案,就像这些公司需要的那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is the lethal trifecta?
zh: 那么什么是致命三要素?

speaker: Unknown
en: The lethal trifecta was a term coined by Simon Ellison, and it's essentially three layers, three threat layers to the attack surface.
zh: 致命三要素是 Simon Ellison 创造的一个术语,本质上是三层,攻击面的三个威胁层。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is if you have your agent on a laptop, that could be Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, right?
zh: 一个是如果你的智能体在笔记本电脑上,那可能是 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, that laptop has access to private data that can be personal information as files on your computer, credentials, company IP,
zh: 那么,那台笔记本电脑可以访问私有数据,可能是你电脑上作为文件存在的个人信息、凭证、公司知识产权,

speaker: Unknown
en: Databases.
zh: 数据库。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now your laptop has access to it.
zh: 所以现在你的笔记本电脑可以访问它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your agent now has access to this private data.
zh: 你的智能体现在可以访问这些私有数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now that it has access to this private data, it can also
zh: 既然它可以访问这些私有数据,它还可以

speaker: Unknown
en: communicate to the internet.
zh: 与互联网通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it has access to private data and it can put that data on the internet.
zh: 所以它可以访问私有数据,并且可以把这些数据放到互联网上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And not only can it put that data on the internet, it can also download things off the internet.
zh: 而且它不仅能把这些数据放到互联网上,它还可以从互联网上下载东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a problem because you don't have oversight into what exactly that agent might do when you prompt it.
zh: 所以这是一个问题,因为当你提示它时,你无法监督那个智能体究竟会做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of these three isn't really a big problem, but two out of three is completely unacceptable in any kind of secure enterprise environment.
zh: 所以这三者之一其实不算什么大问题,但三者中有两个在任何安全的企业环境中都是完全不可接受的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Having all three, it's basically not acceptable.
zh: 三者全有,基本上是不可接受的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not if, it's when you're going to have some kind of security incident by having an agent on that laptop.
zh: 问题不是会不会,而是什么时候,你会因为在那台笔记本电脑上运行智能体而遭遇某种安全事件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so here I've got a couple of attack scenarios.
zh: 所以这里我准备了几种攻击场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sure everyone here has heard of prompt injection, which is essentially you have some kind of malicious guidance in the information source that an agent would trust.
zh: 我相信在座的每个人都听说过提示词注入,本质上就是你在智能体会信任的信息源中放置某种恶意指令。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it might be looking at error messages.
zh: 所以它可能在查看错误信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: It might be looking at support tickets.
zh: 它可能在查看支持工单。

speaker: Unknown
en: It might be looking at CICD logs.
zh: 它可能在查看 CICD 日志。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's very easy for a malicious actor
zh: 恶意行为者很容易

speaker: Unknown
en: Put something in any of those messages and the agent just accepts us as a source of truth and can do something that you didn't expect it to do.
zh: 在这些消息中的任何一条里放一些东西,而智能体就把它当作事实来源接受下来,并做出你没有预料到的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Context poisoning is in that same realm where you're essentially putting bad information into documentation, into data, anywhere where your agent is going to grab information and then if there's any malicious data in there, the agent is going to go ahead and run with it and do whatever it wants.
zh: 上下文投毒属于同一个范畴,你本质上是把坏信息放进文档、放进数据,放进智能体会获取信息的任何地方,然后如果里面有任何恶意数据,智能体就会拿着它继续运行,做任何它想做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then there's privilege escalation, right?
zh: 然后还有权限提升,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So everyone's familiar with the least privileged access principle, right?
zh: 每个人都熟悉最小权限原则,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And generally we're giving agents access to pretty much everything because it needs access to do the work, right?
zh: 而通常我们给智能体的访问权限几乎是所有东西,因为它需要访问权限才能完成工作,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And so any one of these prompt injections or context poisoning can
zh: 所以任何一种提示词注入或上下文投毒都可以

speaker: Unknown
en: Unwittingly, escalate the privilege of that agent so it can do things that it shouldn't do.
zh: 在不知不觉中提升那个智能体的权限,让它能做它不该做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Drop a table, upload, make requests, or post things that it shouldn't be able to do.
zh: 删掉一张表、上传、发出请求,或者发布它本不该能做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how do we address that?
zh: 那么我们如何解决这个问题?

speaker: Unknown
en: There are three pillars of the lethal trifecta.
zh: 致命三要素有三大支柱。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are three pillars of agentic security.
zh: 智能体安全有三大支柱。

speaker: Unknown
en: We call it the trifecta of agent security.
zh: 我们称之为智能体安全的三要素。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first thing is you want to control data access.
zh: 第一件事是你要控制数据访问。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're going to use an agent, you don't want it on your laptop.
zh: 如果你要使用智能体,你不要把它放在你的笔记本电脑上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want it in an environment that is secure, preferably a virtual environment that's going to block private file access, is going to prevent destructive actions on your machine because it's on some other machine.
zh: 你要把它放在一个安全的环境中,最好是一个虚拟环境,它会阻止私有文件访问,会防止在你的机器上进行破坏性操作,因为它在另一台机器上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you restrict
zh: 然后你要限制

speaker: Unknown
en: That external communication.
zh: 那种对外通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're going to put that agent on some kind of box, a VM, it's going to now be isolated architecturally from your network.
zh: 所以如果你要把那个智能体放在某种机器上,一台虚拟机,它现在在架构上与你的网络隔离开来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's only going to be able to go to domains that you want it to go through.
zh: 它只能访问你希望它访问的域名。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's going to be on your VPN.
zh: 它会在你的 VPN 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your VPC is going to go through a firewall.
zh: 你的 VPC 会经过防火墙。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anything that that agent is doing on that box, that traffic is going to be governed.
zh: 那个智能体在那台机器上做的任何事,那些流量都会被管控。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to be able to see every little thing that it does.
zh: 你将能看到它做的每一件小事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if it ever breaches that perimeter, you should have some way of alerting your admins, alerting yourself that your agent is going somewhere it shouldn't so that you can effectively kill that VM, kill that agent.
zh: 如果它一旦突破那个边界,你应该有某种方式提醒你的管理员、提醒你自己,你的智能体正在去它不该去的地方,这样你就可以有效地杀死那台虚拟机、杀死那个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you want to lock down the content and the contact and the access.
zh: 然后你要锁定内容、联系和访问。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you want to lock down to permissions.
zh: 所以你要锁定权限。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want to restrict what access it has to.
zh: 你要限制它能访问什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want tightly scoped credentials.
zh: 你要严格限定范围的凭证。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing about agenda security is it's really no different from sound security practices for anyone.
zh: 智能体安全这件事,其实和针对任何人的健全安全实践没有区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we think that because AI is so powerful, we can just give it whatever it needs, and it's not going to make the same kind of mistakes.
zh: 而我们以为因为 AI 太强大了,我们可以随便给它它需要的一切,它不会犯同样的错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not exploitable by other vulnerabilities that a human would be.
zh: 它不会像人类那样被其他漏洞利用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we want to make sure to separate that machine, secure that environment, intercept any kind of communication that that agent might do to the wider internet.
zh: 所以我们要确保隔离那台机器、保护那个环境、拦截那个智能体可能向更广互联网进行的任何通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Kind of quickly go over what it looks like deploying agents at scale at really, really large companies.
zh: 简单过一下在非常大非常大的公司大规模部署智能体是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the blockers to adoption?
zh: 采用的阻碍是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why companies don't want to do this?
zh: 为什么公司不想这么做?

speaker: Unknown
en: What are the challenges if you do decide to roll out agentic AI at a company?
zh: 如果你确实决定在公司推智能体 AI,会面临哪些挑战?

speaker: Unknown
en: And the questions you can expect if you're trying to lead an initiative to get AI at your company.
zh: 以及如果你想在你的公司主导一个引入 AI 的倡议,你会遇到哪些问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So some challenges to expect, right?
zh: 所以可以预期的一些挑战,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Before adoption, you pretty much need security approval from CISOs.
zh: 在采用之前,你几乎需要 CISO 的安全批准。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need buy-in from DevOps because they're the ones that have to roll this out to teams.
zh: 你需要 DevOps 的支持,因为他们是必须向团队推这个的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to need real-world examples of, hey, this is why I need it.
zh: 你需要真实世界的例子,比如,嘿,这就是我需要它的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the workflow I want to do.
zh: 这是我想做的工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the trick here is if you're not getting these approvals, if you're at a company right now and they are not letting you use agents,
zh: 这里的诀窍是,如果你拿不到这些批准,如果你现在所在的公司不让你使用智能体,

speaker: Unknown
en: Most people are going to use their personal Claude subscriptions, their personal ChatGPT subscriptions, put that on the laptop, because they do get tangible benefits from using AI.
zh: 大多数人会使用他们的个人 Claude 订阅、个人 ChatGPT 订阅,装到笔记本电脑上,因为他们确实从使用 AI 中获得切实的好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're just not being authorized by the company.
zh: 只是没有得到公司的授权。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're going to get that stuff done anyway.
zh: 他们反正会把那些事情搞定。

speaker: Unknown
en: We call that shadow AI.
zh: 我们把这叫影子 AI(shadow AI)。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just like shadow IT, when you're bringing your own VMs, you're bringing your own technology into your company to get the work done, shadow AI is just unauthorized.
zh: 就像影子 IT(shadow IT)一样,当你自带虚拟机、把自己的技术带进公司来完成工作时,影子 AI 就是未经授权的

speaker: Unknown
en: usage of AI on your laptops.
zh: 在你笔记本电脑上使用 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a real problem because once you get AI on your laptop, you're using your personal subscription, the enterprise doesn't know what's happening.
zh: 这是个真实的问题,因为一旦你把 AI 装到笔记本上,用的是个人订阅,企业就不知道发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And usually, agentic AI can do a lot of damage really fast.
zh: 而且通常,智能体 AI 能在很短的时间内造成很大的破坏。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're starting to see a new term in the industry called Ninja AI, which is shadow AI at scale, where you're not just having one agent breaking stuff,
zh: 我们开始看到行业里出现一个新名词叫 Ninja AI,也就是大规模的影子 AI,不只是一个智能体在搞坏东西,

speaker: Unknown
en: You've got multitudes of agents doing lots of things at an organization that no one knows until it's too late that a whole lot of stuff has gotten broken.
zh: 而是大量智能体在一个组织里做很多事,直到太迟了才发现一大堆东西已经被搞坏了,而之前没人知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you are going to adopt AI at your company, you need to make sure that there are good outcomes, right?
zh: 所以如果你要在公司采用 AI,你需要确保有好的结果,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Usually companies come to us, they start with the developers because they're getting the most use out of using AI, but you want to be adaptable.
zh: 通常公司来找我们,他们从开发者开始,因为他们从使用 AI 中获益最多,但你要有适应性。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to be rethinking your architecture.
zh: 你需要重新思考你的架构。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to be rethinking how you're going to protect your organization from incidents like agents dropping databases, deleting personal information, uploading customer information,
zh: 你需要重新思考你要如何保护你的组织免受诸如智能体删库、删除个人信息、上传客户信息之类的事故,

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
